subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 13, September 2nd, 2026, The hearing came off. The charge did not move.
body:
The hearing came off. The charge did not move.

Carousel No. 13, September 2nd, 2026

Did NOT meet the bar: 6.562 against 6.8. Read before posting.

What degraded

  • The deck HELD at 6.562 against a 6.8 bar with zero hard fails surviving, so it does not merge and it is not posted. This is round 2 of the rubric's 5, not the cap, so the deck is unfinished rather than shipped under the bar.
  • The panel raised three hard fails in round one and all three were right. The deck's PREMISE was the largest: the caption, the title and frame 1 asserted that the canceled September 3rd meeting was the hearing on the AI interim charge, and nothing in the record joins them. The listing's row carries a committee, a type, an hour and a room and no subject, the committee's page lists no meeting against the charge, and the notice that would join them is behind a robots-disallowed path. Repaired, and the repaired deck is better than the one it replaced.
  • What holds the deck under the bar now is craft and story rather than integrity. One primitive, a lighter rectangle holding type seated on granite, carries five of nine frames, and the detail budget is front-loaded exactly opposite to the argument, which ends on frames 7 to 9. That is not repairable by another copy pass.
  • This run spent fourteen agent invocations before its panel. The owner flagged the cost twice while it ran. plan_render_check reported 0 of 44 acceptance items asserting anything a render could contradict, so forty-four planning sentences had exactly one reader, a pixel critic. It is 13 of 69 now. next_run.md carries the three cuts.
  • Two gates could not do their job on this deck and both are upgrade lane. numeral_trace names a remedy aggregate_check refuses, and label_guard cannot run at all on a deck that places no map marks.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The hearing came off. The charge did not move., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Thursday was booked. The listing now reads canceled.

The Senate Committee on Economic Development had a public hearing set for September 3rd. The listing gives the committee and no subject. That committee carries an interim charge to "Study the impact of AI on the Texas workforce and its implications for economic competitiveness."

A hearing can come off the calendar. The work the committee is charged to examine does not.

Northside ISD turns ChatGPT for Teachers on for all staff in October. The district said it would not immediately allow student access. Protesters gathered near Riverside Drive and South Congress Avenue. A union member said scheduling software drives patient assignments and sometimes short staffs them.

The same listing carries the committee in E1.016 on September 22nd.

What should the committee hear on September 22nd?

Notes

# Next run, from 2026-09-02 ## Spend fewer agents. This is the top item. Carousel no. 13 spent fourteen agent invocations before its panel and held at 6.562 anyway. The owner flagged the cost twice during the run. The routine's own prompt already says the cheapest round is the one you do not need, and this run did not honour it. Three concrete cuts, in order of what they save: 1. **Write acceptance items a machine can fail, at planning time.** `plan_render_check` reported **0 of 44** items on this deck asserting anything a render could contradict, so forty-four planning sentences had exactly one reader, a pixel critic at three cents a token. It is 13 of 69 now and every one holds. An item quoting a string and saying the frame carries it, or that it appears nowhere, is checked for free on every render. 2. **One pixel-critic round, not two.** Round one found five assertions the sources did not carry and a value argument inverted in the pixels. Round two found materially less per agent. Spend the second round only on frames round one marked `revise` with a must_fix. 3. **The flow critic is the highest-yield agent in the phase and it ran once, last.** It found the thing no gate could see: frame 4 published frame 9's whole payload five frames early, so the colour reserved across nine frames for one reveal arrived to confirm a fact. Run it EARLIER, on the first render, where its findings still cost one re-render instead of nine. ## Do not open on an absence This was the fifth deck of thirteen built on what a document does not say, and deck 11's own ledger entry already asked for something else: "The absence hook is now the house habit rather than a choice, and the next run should spend an opening move that is not an absence." Deck 12 complied. Deck 13 went straight back to it and gave a whole frame the kicker WHAT IS NOT PUBLISHED. Related: `closing_moves_recent` now reads "Ask the one question the decision leaves open." four runs running. It is not on the restricted list, which covers opening moves for six runs and structures for three. Four in a row is a habit whatever the list says. Restrict it or spend it deliberately. ## Spend the detail budget where the argument ends The craft judge scored `artwork_craft` at 5.5 and named the reason: one primitive, a lighter rectangle holding type seated on granite under a two-part contact shadow, carried five of nine frames, and frames 1 to 5 got four genuinely different drawings while 6 to 9 got one. The deck's argument ends on 7 to 9. Plan the back half first next time. ## Two gates to fix, both `upgrade` lane - `numeral_trace` names a remedy `aggregate_check` refuses. See the run record. - `label_guard` cannot run at all on a deck that places no map marks. Also worth a gate: an acceptance item like "the engraved line density stops at least 24px clear of every glyph" is **vacuously satisfied by a frame with no engraved line**, which is how frame 8 declared white-line intaglio and shipped two brushed plates past its own list. ## The codex automation still re-verifies the same ledger `ledger/docket.json` is re-verified by this routine and by a codex automation, and the two produced 128 conflicts in one day. It will recur. Decide which one owns the file.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
